name: Assault Mastery
summary: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Black-winged Vigilance
summary: Ravenwing Fly units' ranged attacks gain Ignores Cover. Army can include Dark Angels units only, no other Chapter's Adeptus Astartes units.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability gain: Furor Tactics — if the devastator doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; Malleus Tactics — if the tactical doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS]; Purgatus Tactics — if the assault doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of it have [PRECISION]. DEATHWATCH units may be included regardless of Chapter faction keyword, to a combined maximum of 500 points. Unless otherwise stated, a DEATHWATCH model cannot be your WARLORD. KILL TEAM units take enhancements only from this detachment.

name: Devastator Mastery
summary: Each battle, you can select the devastator doctrine one additional time.

name: Combined Deployment
summary: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks; that enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Codex Discipline
summary: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of three Combat Doctrines. Until the start of your next Command phase, it is active and applies to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Each Combat Doctrine can only be selected once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: the unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Walking Fortress
summary: In a turn in which a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Defence
summary: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Vowed Target
summary: At the start of your Movement phase, select one option. Defensive Footing: select one objective you control; until the start of your next Movement phase it is your Vowed objective. Aggressive Push: select one or more objectives you do not control; until the start of your next Movement phase each is one of your Vowed objectives, rules referring to range of your Vowed objective apply if within range of one or more of them, and DEATHWING INFANTRY units add 1 to the Wound roll when attacking a unit within range of one or more of them. Army cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

name: Enduring Vengeance
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, excluding Walker units, can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll when making ranged attacks.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: After a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot, choose one of the following effects: those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden; or that unit can make a normal move of up to D6", and that unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, each friendly Phobos unit that is hidden gains the ability to re-roll wound rolls of 1 for its attacks until the end of the turn.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes units with the Mounted or Speeder keyword have +2" Move characteristic.

name: Tactical Mastery
summary: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
summary: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
summary: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

name: Death Blow
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

name: Dutiful Tenacity
summary: Attacks stronger than an Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit's Toughness get -1 to the Wound roll.
